changes.title: Gaming over Wi-Fi instead of a cable
changes.finding: primary adapter Intel(R) Wireless-AC 9462 is wireless
changes.expected_effect: Lower jitter and fewer latency spikes on the first hop.

steps.description: Switch the gaming PC from Wi-Fi to a wired Ethernet cable
steps.text:
1. Connect an Ethernet cable from the PC to the router
2. Open Settings > Network and confirm the Ethernet adapter shows Connected
3. Disconnect Wi-Fi or set the Ethernet adapter metric lower than Wi-Fi
4. Re-run the live latency monitor and compare p95 before and after
steps.notes: No registry value reproduces a cable; the medium itself is the fix.

changes.title: Slow domain name resolver
changes.expected_effect: Faster connection setup for new sessions and services.

steps.description: Point all adapters at fast public resolvers (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8)
steps.notes: Undo returns the adapters to DHCP-provided resolvers.

changes.title: Graphics driver queues frames ahead
changes.finding: driver frame queueing on NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 was not confirmed optimal
changes.expected_effect: Input appears on screen up to one frame sooner.

steps.description: Enable the lowest-latency frame mode in the GPU driver panel
steps.text:
1. NVIDIA: Control Panel > Manage 3D settings > Low Latency Mode > Ultra
2. AMD: Adrenalin > Graphics > Anti-Lag > Enabled
3. Intel: Arc Control > Performance > Low Latency > On
4. Restart the game and confirm the setting survived the reboot
steps.notes: One fewer queued frame removes a full frame time of input lag.

changes.title: Background programs fight the game for CPU
changes.finding: background load competes with the game: python (15.0%)
changes.expected_effect: Fewer preemptions while the heaviest competitor idles lower.

steps.description: Lower python to BelowNormal priority while gaming
steps.notes: Transient only; priorities reset when the process restarts.
